# BluetoothCommunicator 1.0.6

Mini Conversation vendors the Java sources from
[`com.github.niedev:BluetoothCommunicator:1.0.6`](https://github.com/niedev/BluetoothCommunicator)
under `app/src/main/java/com/bluetooth/communicator/`.

- Original author: Luca Martino / niedev
- Original license: Apache License 2.0
- Original artifact source SHA-256: `CA69AB1F1DD3B60C9CD1A1C100C0A594CF39E86DF69FD2263347DCFC5F6886F9`
- Local changes: sensitive logging removed; inbound fragment parsing, ordering, size,
  concurrency, and timeout limits added; malformed input is rejected without changing
  the public API or legacy wire framing.

The original copyright and Apache-2.0 header is retained in each vendored source file.
